name: Grazing Strike
description: Strikes made with this weapon inflict half damage and inflict appropriate weapon skill effects if the strike at least matches the target's combined movement and bonus DVs.

name: Charge
description: The character uses their altered strike to rush 10' forward + 5' per additional rank in a straight line, making an attack roll against every target whose space they move through. They then make a single damage roll against all targets they hit, adding any applicable bonuses from Grazing Strike, Cleave Armor, Knockout, Lethal, or Concussive Strike to all successfully struck.

name: Cleave Armor
description: The next successful strike this turn reduces the target's armor DVs by 1 per rank until the start of the character's next turn. Cleave armor cannot reduce the target's armor DVs below 0.

name: Concussive
description: The next successful strike this turn befuddles the target until the end of their next turn, HE save to negate.

name: Knockout
description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose a core action until the end of their next turn, or instead be knocked unconscious if they are below half their maximum HP, their choice of a WIL or HEA save to negate either effect.

name: Launch
description: The character executes an action, launching themselves or another target 20' per rank in any direction, AGI or STR save (target's choice) to negate. If the target is of a similar size or smaller in comparison to the character and grappled, they cannot resist the effect. This ability requires a suitable surface to push off of if used on oneself.

name: Lethal IV
description: Each rank purchased allows the character to add 4 damage to a single strike they make this turn.
